g.text: Years relative to release date (0 = release)
Rows ordered by release date (oldest at top); LTS and interim releases in separate panels
Ubuntu release life cycles aligned on each release date
Aligned on release, life cycles are near-identical within each type: every release has ~0.5 years of development, interim releases get a median 0.7 years of standard support (1.5 before
13.04) and then end, while LTS releases get a median 5.0 years and (since 14.04 LTS) stack ESM and Legacy phases out to 15 years after release.
